purpose: P11a transitional old Windows downloader; one shared release policy with the Qt updater, removed with the old UI after migration acceptance

existingImplementation.reuse: Preserve the existing app-owned observation, idle daily checks, delayed consent, Downloads, name collision and same-version download behavior; directly call the existing FileIdentity/FileCommitter implementations.

sharedPolicy.adaptation: Move manifest identity, package selection, contentRoot/dependency/path checks and bounded header guards into std-only core. QJsonDocument and Windows.Data.Json remain the actual parsers; no new JSON parser or second metadata controller.

consultedSources.reuse: Source review of actual Label/Text measurement; no Ling source copied. Existing public DirectWrite layout adds complete explicit lines before the same Yoga layout.

boundaries: No Windows/WinRT implementation or alternate HTTP/TLS library was copied; the adapter uses the same native Windows runtime already present in the old product.
